avis.texte: At first I was not a fan because I thought it had caused irritation. I tried to return it but it was past the 60 day return window. I decided to give it another try, and I am really happy that I did! It must have been something else that irritated my skin initially. After a few uses, no sigh of any irritation. I love the formula! I don't feel it is sticky. Maybe a little when first applied, but once it dries and moisturizer is applied, there is no sticky feeling. It is nice and light. Absorbs right into the skin. It gives a beautiful, radiant look. This product has really helped keep my skin nice and hydrated. Even during the really cold winter months we had here on the east coast. I tend to have pretty dry skin, especially in the winter. I just love this product. At first, I was hesitant to purchase it as it doesnt have raving reviews. But, I took a chance, and I'm so glad I did! I am now on my second bottle and will continue to purchase.

I wanted to love this bc my skin loves heartleaf but unfortunately this formulation leaves my skin feeling sticky on application and oily throughout the day even on freezing winter days. Not a win for me!

I was looking for a serum I could use in combination with actives to soothe and hydrate my skin. I started to add this serum into my routine to balance the effects of my exfoliating products and it has really helped! It's simple enough to not irritate the skin when using strong ahas/bhas and provides much needed hydration!

I've been using this product for a couple of years now (used to order from Korea it's so good) because I always come back! It's a very soothing formula. I like to use it if my skin's been looking a little dull or dry. I also cycle between actives by using this as a buffer of sorts. Ex: retinoid on monday, heartleaf ampoule on tuesday, azelaic acid wednesday, and then repeat the cycle.
